A cute ghostie pet bunny familiar for any witch ♡

This mod was made possible because of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25216?tab=description]this mod[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/149208243]NexusModsUser92384[/url] so thank you so much for making a pet rabbit mod!! ♡

I hope you enjoy this mod and thank you for your support ♡
